lines.zh: 我在远处站着，其实我刚挪了一点。
lines.en: I stand far off; in fact I just moved a little.

lines.zh: 你不看我的时候，我才走。
lines.en: I only walk when you are not looking.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，慢得几乎看不出。
lines.en: One step at a time, so slow it barely shows.
My white shape shifts between the trees.

lines.zh: 每次你回头，我都远了一点点。
lines.en: Each time you turn, I am a little farther.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的视线之外走。
lines.en: I walk outside the edge of your sight.
My feet leave no prints.

lines.zh: 我前进的距离，你测不出来。
lines.en: You cannot measure how far I advance.
I close one more block.

lines.zh: 我绕过那棵树，到另一边。
lines.en: I go around the tree to the other side.
I slide past the edge of your vision.
I will never actually reach you.
I change position in the fog.

lines.zh: 你眨一下眼，我就到了别处。
lines.en: You blink, and I am elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的白影总比我先到一步。
lines.en: My white outline always arrives a step before me.
I stand and watch you.

lines.zh: 我的白色身影融进雾里。
lines.en: My white shape melts into the fog.
There is another behind you too.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候更像不存在。
lines.en: Still, I seem even less real.
I wait for you to notice.

lines.zh: 白色的我在远处，数你的气。
lines.en: The white figure counts your breaths from afar.
The fog wraps around me.
I tilt my head slightly.
I keep exactly one distance from you.
My face will not come clear.
I have been in the same place all along.
I am like a standing sheet of white.

lines.zh: 眼睛在我身上出现又消失。
lines.en: Eyes appear on me and vanish.
I am far away, always far away.

lines.zh: 我在看你，你也看见我了。
lines.en: I am watching you, and you have seen me.

lines.zh: 你别眨眼，我一眨就换地方。
lines.en: Don't blink; one blink and I shift.
Come closer and I am gone.

lines.zh: 我的脸对着你，可你没有看清。
lines.en: My face is toward you, and you cannot make it out.
You have been looking at me a long time.
My white stands out in the night.
Turning around was the right move.

lines.zh: 我一直在你视线的边上。
lines.en: I have always been at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我站在你能看见的边缘。
lines.en: I stand at the edge of what you can see.
Would you like to take a picture?

lines.zh: 我这样站着，你觉得安心吗？
lines.en: Does my standing here comfort you?
Have you counted how many of me there are?
You turn, and there I am.

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，你就怕了。
lines.en: I have done nothing, and you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你看不清我有没有受伤。
lines.en: You cannot tell if I am hurt.
I have no blood.

lines.zh: 我淡了一下，又退回原处。
lines.en: I fade a little and settle back where I was.
The white fades for an instant.
You did not hit anything.
The air drops one degree.
I look at you and say nothing.
So even I can feel pain.
You hold something out; I do not need it.
I don't eat. I only watch.
It has no shape to my eyes.
Lowering it will not help.

lines.zh: 你这么害怕，还想着喂我？
lines.en: So afraid, yet you would feed me?

lines.zh: 我看了看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I look at what you hold.
It will not hold me back.
You would do better to stop.
I watch you, not it.
Your hand will not stop shaking.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我却只看见你的手。
lines.en: You hold it up, but I only see your hand.
Food takes no shape for me.

lines.zh: 你喂我，是想让我离开吗？
lines.en: Are you feeding me to make me leave?

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我连头都没低。
lines.en: You hold it out; I don't even dip my head.
What you hold will go cold.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我的影子晃了一下。
lines.en: We meet and my shape ripples.
You touch me and I am cold as fog.

lines.zh: 我消散了一下，又聚回来。
lines.en: I scatter, then gather again.
I recede half a step and stop.
This distance should not exist.
Your breath passes through me.
I say nothing.
The air between us goes cold.
I withdraw quickly again.
There are several others around.
Not one of us speaks.

lines.zh: 我们围成一个不完整的圈。
lines.en: We form an incomplete circle.
You are standing in the middle.
We neither close in nor leave.
The fog is full of white outlines.
We all tilt our heads at once.
The moon shifts a little.
Then we scatter again.
I crouch and pick it up.
It grows cold in my hand.
I raise it to the moonlight.
Keep it, and you will come back.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原处，等你再回来。
lines.en: I set it back where it was, for your return.
This makes me clearer.
I squeeze it like squeezing fog.
I hand it to you.

lines.zh: 你接过去的时候手在抖。
lines.en: Your hand shakes as you take it.
You are staring at me.
Then I must not move.
Come close, and I come apart.

lines.zh: 雾里，我把你的脸看清楚了。
lines.en: In the fog, I've made out your face.
There is one more behind you.
I make no sound. I only watch.
Do you hear the wind?
That is not wind.
I am on your left.
You turn, and I am not there.
Now I am on your right.

lines.zh: 你的步子一乱，我就近了一格。
lines.en: Your steps falter, and I close one square.
The fog is thickening.
You are counting how many of us there are.
You stop at the fourth.
Only when you don't look do I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，可我一直在走。
lines.en: I have no feet, yet I keep walking.
Yet a mark appeared on you.

lines.zh: 空气变冷了，你该感觉到。
lines.en: The air turns cold; you should feel it.
You simply walked into it yourself.
My white presses to your face.
Your heart is racing.
I could not say what happened.
At last, you're willing to look at me.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，你却感觉不到。
lines.en: I reach out, and you feel nothing at all.
A white shape appears in the fog.
I was here before you came.
A pale figure stands beyond the treeline.

lines.zh: 我没有出现，我只是被看见了。
lines.en: I did not appear; I was simply seen.
There is something in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 白色的轮廓定在一段距离外。
lines.en: The white outline settles at one distance.
The night has one more shadow.
I am neither born nor dying.
You look up and I am already there.
I stand quietly until you notice.
Somewhere in the world, things go wrong.

lines.zh: 我用你熟悉的方式站着。
lines.en: I stand in a way you find familiar.

lines.zh: 火穿过我落在地上，我的轮廓抖了抖。
lines.en: Fire passes through me to the ground and my outline trembles.

lines.zh: 坠落对我来说没有意义。
lines.en: Falling means nothing to me.
Water passes through me; I keep standing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散了，一会儿又聚起来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; I gather again presently.

lines.zh: 箭从我身体里穿过去，钉在树上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me and sticks in a tree.

lines.zh: 咒光让我的轮廓亮了一下。
lines.en: Spell-light makes my outline flare.

lines.zh: 我从不进食，也从不饱足。
lines.en: I never eat and am never full.

lines.zh: 闪电照亮了我，一瞬间你都看清了。
lines.en: Lightning lights me up, and for a moment you see everything.

lines.zh: 虚空里我也在，远远看着。
lines.en: I am in the void too, watching from far off.
